newsitem.title: USA: Thermo Fibergen revises IPO terms.
newsitem.headline: Thermo Fibergen revises IPO terms.

text.p: Thermo Fibergen Inc has raised the number of units it plans to offer in its upcoming initial public offering and fixed the estimated price at $12.75 a unit, according to a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commisison.
The company had previously planned to offer 3.1 million units, each consisting of one share and one warrant, and had put the estimated pricing range at $12.50 to $13.50 a unit.

Thermo Fibergen, which has filed to trade under the Nasdaq symbol "TFG" on the American Stock Exchange, is a subsidiary of Thermo Fibertek Inc, which is an 81.5 percent owned subsidiary of Thermo Electron Corp.
The IPO is scheduled to price on September 12 and begin trading September 13.
